# GTA Junk and Property Cleanout Inc.

> Premium, white-glove junk removal and property cleanouts serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. We don't just haul junk away — we clear the space, sweep it, and hand it back showable. Positioning line: "We find your floor again."

## Key facts

- **Business name:** GTA Junk and Property Cleanout Inc.
- **Type:** Service-area business (we travel to the customer; no walk-in storefront). Based in northwest Etobicoke (M9V), Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
- **Phone:** (647) 204-0632 — open 7 days a week, 7am–9pm
- **Email:** gtajunkandpropertycleanout@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca
- **Status:** Licensed and insured. New company (launched 2026) — we publish only real work and real reviews, never stock imagery or invented testimonials.
- **What sets us apart:** fixed price quoted in writing before anything moves (no hourly creep); floors and door frames protected; donate and recycle before landfill; every job ends swept at minimum.

## Services

- **Garage cleanouts** (our signature service): packed to the rafters back to bare, degreased concrete — usually one visit. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/garage-cleanouts/
- **Junk removal:** furniture, appliances, renovation debris, single items to full loads. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/junk-removal/
- **Property cleanouts:** turnovers, downsizing, pre-sale purges — cleared, swept, handed back showable. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/pre-listing-cleanouts/
- **Estate cleanouts:** discreet crews who protect what matters and donate what can live on. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/estate-cleanouts/
- **Restoration & insurance debris removal** (B2B): fire, flood, and demolition debris for restoration companies. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/insurance-restoration-cleanouts/
- **Commercial cleanouts** (B2B): offices, retail, warehouses, tenant/unit turnovers for property managers. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/commercial-cleanouts/
- **Hoarding cleanouts:** heavy-clutter properties cleared with dignity and discretion; confirmed biohazard referred to a licensed partner. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/hoarding-cleanouts/
- **Common specific items we remove:** hot tubs, mattresses, couches and sofas, appliances (fridges, freezers, washers), sheds, treadmills, pianos, old furniture.

## Pricing (starting prices by job type)

Every job is priced in a free on-site valuation and fixed in writing before work begins. We do not quote blind over the phone. All prices before HST. **Every booking is confirmed with a 30% deposit**, which comes off the final invoice.

- **Estate Standard Cleanout — from $2,000:** full property cleared, valuables and documents set aside for the family, donation-first sorting, handed back swept and showable.
- **Estate Signature Cleanout — from $3,200:** everything in Standard plus Keep & Cherish item delivery, deep clean, detailed floors, written inventory of apparent valuables, photographed handover for out-of-province executors.
- **Hoarding Cleanout Tier 1 — from $4,000:** heavy clutter excavated room by room at a pace the resident sets; valuables, cash and documents recovered and returned; unmarked discreet arrival.
- **Hoarding Cleanout Tier 2+ — from $8,000:** severe accumulation, access problems, multi-day projects. Custom quote after a confidential walkthrough. Confirmed biohazard is referred to a licensed remediation partner; we handle the non-hazardous bulk.
- **Pre-Listing / Realtor-Ready Cleanout — from $1,500:** cleared, depersonalised and stage-prepped so listing photographs can be taken the same week.
- **Insurance / Restoration Debris Removal — from $1,800:** fire, flood and demolition debris in one continuous haul, weigh tickets and photographs documented for the adjuster.
- **Commercial Cleanout — from $2,500:** offices, retail, warehouses, multiplex turnovers. COIs on file, Net-30 trade terms, after-hours scheduling.
- **Garage Cleanout (Signature Finish) — from $1,500:** packed to the rafters back to bare, degreased concrete, usually one visit.

We are a premium operator. We are not the cheapest quote you will get, and we say so plainly: the price covers property protection, donation sorting, a crew that carries rather than drags, and a finished space rather than an emptied one.

We also offer a video estimate: a customer films a short phone walkthrough and gets a rough price. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/see-your-price/

## Verified local disposal knowledge

Our city pages carry municipal disposal rules verified against official regional sources (e.g., Peel Region no longer collects large appliances from the curb; Toronto, York, Halton, and Durham rules differ). These are dated and sourced. Useful when answering "how do I get rid of [item] in [city]."
